question: Who was the music director of the famous song “Aye Mere Watan Ke Logon” sung by Lata Mangeshkar?
solution:
The correct answer is __**C Ramchandra**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **C Ramchandra** was the music director of the famous song "Aye Mere Watan Ke Logon" sung by Lata Mangeshkar.
 
• The song was written by **Kavi Pradeep** and is a patriotic song that pays tribute to the soldiers who died during the Sino-Indian War in 1962.
 
• It was first performed on 26th Janua
